source.algorithm: sha256(path + space + sha256 + newline), sorted by path

limits: Inventory identifies supporting scope, not a claim of line-by-line review of every UI or dependency file. All 26 production Solidity files were re-reviewed in full. Runtime templates contain unpatched immutables; they are not deployed runtime allowlist values. Secret environments, databases, generated build/cache directories and historical deployments are excluded. No production approval.
